description: Buys and sells measured compute and RPC on the Taifoon Grid: AI, GPU and TEE calls, hiring resources, joining with your own, earnings. For agent work use taifoon_find and taifoon_hire. Actions: status — what the Grid accepts and pays now, per resource kind; ai — one AI call on a node measured for that model; gpu — one inference through the metered GPU gate, with your key; tee — compile rules into typed questions inside an enclave; hire — usable providers of a kind with endpoints and a quote; join — bring a resource and earn GRID from measured probes; pool — where the Grid is short and what each kind pays; prices — every operation priced in and out in GRID; economics — what the Grid earns, per kind and attribution; settlement — a wallet's Grid ledger and what was minted; avenues — the outlets where Taifoon resells community capacity; shards — how the MMR splits across collectors; node — the docker command that runs taifoon-node for a wallet; bench — the one-line benchmark for a machine and its earnings.

action.description: what to do (default status): status | ai | gpu | tee | hire | join | pool | prices | economics | settlement | avenues | shards | node | bench

api_key.description: api key (actions: gpu, tee, hire, join)

chain_id.description: settlement chain (default 8453, Base — where the assurance contract is live) (actions: ai, join)

collectors.description: plan for this many collectors instead of the live swarm (actions: shards)

compose.description: provision/quote: an allowlisted compose id (taifoon-tee-seller) or its file’s sha256; absent = the first on the allowlist (actions: tee)

hirer.description: optional 0x wallet; records the intent in the Grid ledger (actions: ai, hire)

id.description: status/release: the enclave id (enc_…) (actions: tee, avenues)

me.description: your libp2p peer id (base58) — returns your shard, config and command (actions: shards)

model.description: the model the node must serve (e.g. hypernova-60b, littlelamb) (actions: ai, gpu, join)

note.description: optional, ≤200 chars, stored with the intent (actions: hire)

owner.description: 0x wallet address that earns the GRID points (actions: join, economics, node, bench)

payout.description: Optional: grid (default, the full rate) or cash (USDC at the TSUL rate, 70 %) (actions: node)

pool.description: Leave it out: the pool is Taifoon's side and is derived on the server (the Taifoon founding pool, fee 0). Kept only for nodes from before 2026-10-11 that still send one; honoured on first registration only. (actions: join)

provider.description: optional: a specific measured endpoint from the providers list (actions: ai)

ref.description: Optional: the 0x wallet that referred this resource. It earns a share of what the resource accrues (measured work only). Never the owner itself. (actions: join, node)

reference.description: kind=gpu: the market class your price is checked against (default llama-3.1-8b) (actions: join)

resource.description: only avenues for this resource (actions: avenues)

sell.description: kind=gpu: true lists the node for sale at the BROKER's market price for its reference class (the rig never names a price; the cheapest other venue, input and output apart, sets it); the node is checked (battery + fingerprint) and owned by your key (actions: join)

vram_gb.description: VRAM of one card in GB (0 or omitted = no GPU) (actions: bench)

name: taifoon_grid
title: Grid compute and resources
